title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.
